slot.brief: Two/three statements about doctors, artists and painters; ask which conclusions definitely/sossibly follow, including a possibility statement.

stem:
**Statements:**
Some doctors are artists.
All painters are artists.

**Conclusions:**
I. Some doctors are artists.
II. Some doctors being painters is a possibility.

verdicts.working: I restates the given statement, so it follows. Nothing rules out doctors also being painters; that overlap is compatible with all painters being artists, so II is possible.

working:
I repeats the first statement, so it follows. Painters are artists, and the statements do not exclude doctors from being painters; the groups can overlap. Thus II is possible too.

Independent check: I restates the given statement, so it follows. Nothing rules out doctors also being painters; that overlap is compatible with all painters being artists, so II is possible.
solution: Conclusion I restates the first statement, so it follows. Since all painters are artists and no statement excludes doctors from being painters, some doctors being painters is possible; hence II also follows.
